Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S14 Two patients sharing a last name: the tapped card opens exactly that one

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 5)
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-01; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given seededCensus H1 'Ana Rivera' (412) and H2 'Ben Rivera' (415); N1 'Dora Nguyen' and N2 'Hoa Nguyen'

When Sort by name, search the shared last name, tap the second card, go back, tap the first; same in Nursing Home

Then Each chart header shows the tapped patient's own name and room, never the neighbour's

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: each chart checkpoint mustContain the tapped name (+ room for Hospital) and 'Admission status' (chart header only, so a list filtered to one card cannot pass), and mustNotContain the other name
